financial_baseline.current_public_signal: Unmodified opinion with repeat control findings; FY2024-2025 budget also public

MD&A reports salaries and benefits as 37% of its expense-type chart; separate salary/benefit dollars and the chart's dollar denominator are not disclosed. Water/Sewer operating income was $2.67M; audit reported a material weakness.
MD&A was omitted and no salary object schedule appears. Current-year TRS covered payroll was $21.75M and OPEB covered-employee payroll $23.08M; these are corroborating bases, not salary expense.

fiscal_measures.detail: A current validated countywide project list was not established in this quick pass.

The official November 2025 ballot authorized up to $50M of general-obligation bonds and up to $45M of one-cent E-SPLOST collections over no more than 20 quarters. The measure passed 3,263 Yes to 1,022 No. The Athletic and Sports Complex and technology capital are expressly authorized; authorization does not prove implementation.
The FY2024-2025 county budget shows $1.1 million of budgeted T-SPLOST tax revenue and $1.354 million total T-SPLOST revenue including fund balance and interest.
Keep separate from capital sales taxes; current distribution and dependence are not yet validated.
Outstanding county, city and school bond obligations require current debt schedules and official validation.
